    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ClassEvent
    Stores information about changes made to a Java class.
    ClassLifecycleListener
    Tracks changes made to Java classes in BlueJ.
    CompileError
    Stores information about a compilation error or warning.
    CompileEvent
    Stores information about a compilation attempt in BlueJ.
    ConsoleOutputCapture
    Captures text written to System.out and System.err.
    ConsoleSummary
    Reads saved console output and creates a summary to include in the ReportNow reports
    ExecutionListener
    Tracks program execution results in BlueJ.
    ExportContext
    Allows ReportNow to choose which exporter to use.
    ExportException
    Handles errors that occur while generating reports
    ExportStrategy
    Defines the method used to export ReportNow session data.
    JsonExporter
    Creates JSON reports using the telemetry data collected by ReportNow It uses Jackson's ObjectMapper to save the information.
    LoadPastSessions
    Reads previously saved JSON reports to retrieve information about earlier ReportNow sessions.
    MethodCounter
    Counts the methods found in a Java source file.
    ParseCompileErrors
    Reads compilation messages and extracts error or warning details.
    PdfExporter
    Creates PDF reports using the telemetry data collected by ReportNow.
    ProjectEvent
    Stores information about activities involving a BlueJ project.
    ProjectLifecycleListener
    Tracks activities involving BlueJ projects.
    RecordCompile
    Tracks compilation attempts in BlueJ.
    ReportNowExtension
    Main class for the ReportNow BlueJ extension.
    RunEvent
    Stores information about a program execution in BlueJ.
    SessionData
    Stores the activity data collected during a ReportNow session.
    SessionSummary
    Stores a summary of a ReportNow session.
    StoreStudentId
    StoreStudentId Handles the student Id prompt used in ReportNow when a user opens BlueJ
    TelemetryEvent
    Acts as the parent class for ReportNow telemetry events.
    TrackDocumentEdits
    Monitors changes in the length of text in a BlueJ editor.
    TrackEditor
    Finds open Java editors in BlueJ and monitors them for changes and uses TrackDocumentEdits to record editing activity.
